title: Who are Yemen's Southern Giants Brigades leading the fight against the Houthis?
gist: Saudi-backed Yemeni government forces, spearheaded by the Southern Giants Brigades, launched Operation Yemen Dawn on Oct. 5, 2026 to reverse a Houthi Red Sea coast offensive that had taken Mokha and put the Bab el-Mandeb under Houthi control. Early gains near the strait are real, but durability hinges on the fractious anti-Houthi coalition overcoming its internal rivalries.

insights.claim: In September 2026 the Houthis ran an offensive on Yemen's Red Sea coast that captured strategic locations including the city of Mokha and put the Bab el-Mandeb strait under Houthi control.
insights.speaker: Giorgio Cafiero
insights.so_what: Houthi control of the Bab el-Mandeb chokepoint directly raises Red Sea shipping risk, freight and insurance costs.
insights.quote: capturing many strategic locations including the city of Mokha and putting the Bab el-Mandeb under Houthi control
insights.locator: Yemen's Southern Giants Brigades are proving

insights.claim: Yemen's internationally recognized government and Saudi Arabia launched Operation Yemen Dawn on Oct. 5, 2026 to reverse Houthi gains on the Red Sea coast.
insights.speaker: Giorgio Cafiero
insights.so_what: Marks direct Saudi re-entry into ground-war escalation in Yemen, a renewed regional conflict risk.
insights.quote: the internationally recognized government and Saudi Arabia launching Operation Yemen Dawn on Oct. 5

insights.claim: Saudi-backed Yemeni government forces have retaken several areas near the Bab el-Mandeb, including Dhubab, Bab and Hadeid, since Operation Yemen Dawn began.
insights.speaker: Giorgio Cafiero
insights.so_what: Partial recovery of ground near the strait could ease, but not yet remove, chokepoint risk for shipping.
insights.quote: Saudi-backed government forces have since retaken several areas near the Bab el-Mandeb, including Dhubab, Bab and Hadeid.

insights.claim: The Southern Giants Brigades are the most powerful force in Yemen's government-aligned camp and are spearheading the ground offensive against the Houthis.
insights.speaker: Giorgio Cafiero
insights.so_what: The outcome of the Red Sea coast fighting depends heavily on a single southern militia's capability and loyalty.
insights.quote: Spearheading the offensive on the ground are the Giants Brigades, the most powerful force in the government-aligned camp.

insights.claim: Whether battlefield gains against the Houthis translate into lasting strategic advantage depends on whether the divided anti-Houthi forces, many of which are rivals, can overcome longstanding divisions.
insights.speaker: Giorgio Cafiero
insights.so_what: Investors should discount early gains: coalition infighting could reverse progress and prolong Red Sea disruption.
insights.quote: whether those gains translate into a sustained strategic advantage will depend on the government-aligned forces’ ability to overcome longstanding divisions
